products_purchase_unit_chk.name: products_purchase_unit_chk
products_purchase_unit_chk.value: ("products"."purchase_unit_id" is null) = ("products"."purchase_unit_factor" is null) and ("products"."purchase_unit_factor" is null or "products"."purchase_unit_factor" > 0)

payments_single_document_chk.name: payments_single_document_chk
payments_single_document_chk.value:
(case when "payments"."sale_id" is null then 0 else 1 end
         + case when "payments"."purchase_id" is null then 0 else 1 end
         + case when "payments"."sale_return_id" is null then 0 else 1 end
         + case when "payments"."purchase_return_id" is null then 0 else 1 end) <= 1

payments_direction_document_chk.name: payments_direction_document_chk
payments_direction_document_chk.value:
("payments"."sale_id" is null or "payments"."direction" = 'RECEIVED_FROM_CUSTOMER')
      and ("payments"."purchase_id" is null or "payments"."direction" = 'PAID_TO_SUPPLIER')
      and ("payments"."sale_return_id" is null or "payments"."direction" = 'REFUND_TO_CUSTOMER')
      and ("payments"."purchase_return_id" is null or "payments"."direction" = 'REFUND_FROM_SUPPLIER')

stock_lots_dates_chk.name: stock_lots_dates_chk
stock_lots_dates_chk.value: "stock_lots"."manufacturing_date" is null or "stock_lots"."expiry_date" is null or "stock_lots"."manufacturing_date" <= "stock_lots"."expiry_date"
